rule: Stand-ins for the cell's missing clutter (planner ruling 2026-09-27; as AltenDockmasterHouse): each base form another cell already stands in takes the same stand-in here; the rest stay listed gaps. Drawn at the missing reference's transform by worldgen/export_interior_bundle.py.

substitutions.why: A table stood here; a square plank table takes its place.

With the object unknown, no same-object stand-in (R48) can be chosen.

removalRule: Owner ruling 2026-10-04 (R113): no missing piece ships as a gap. A missing piece takes a same-class stand-in from a published kit where one exists (substitutions[]); a decorative piece whose class no published kit or vault archive holds is taken out of the fit-out (removals[], reason decorative-no-same-class, its search recorded), and the spot is simply empty. A placed piece whose only support was a removed piece is removed with it (reason rests-on-a-removal, restsOn naming that row).
